method: Official site https://www.hiperbodegapreciouno.com.pe (WordPress/Elementor; preciouno.com.pe does not resolve). The 'Nosotros' page has a 'Ubica tu tienda' section with 32 store cards (name, address, format Hiperbodega/Superbodega, link to Google Maps). 31 links are maps.app.goo.gl short links (recorded in notes, NOT resolved - Google Maps was not queried); 1 card (Panamericana Urbana) links a full Google Maps URL whose !3d/!4d coordinates were taken as published. All other lat/lng are null. Added 2 newer stores from press (secondary=true): Comas/Collique (Dec 2025) and Carabayllo (May 2026). 32+2 = 34 = latest reported count (peru-retail 2026-05-19, with regional split Lima+Callao 16, Ica 4, Lambayeque 3, Piura 3, Loreto 2, San Martín 2, La Libertad 2, Junín 1, Ucayali 1 - our list matches that split). Official Tottus 2025 sustainability report says 32 Precio Uno at end-2025. Openings after May 2026 (Falabella planned ~7 Tottus/Precio Uno openings in 2026) were not found and may be missing.
